# WO-105: Missing-page recovery regression tests (CP-05)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)

Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-05 (accepted as proposed)

## Goal
Test-only: the built v3 404 page (web/src/pages/404.astro) has one descriptive H1, noindex, meaningful link text, and home/guide links that resolve to built pages under the configured base path. Report product defects; don't fix them.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests run against web/dist after `pnpm build` and fail clearly if dist is missing.
- They don't duplicate the global CSP/link checks in check-site.mjs.
- ruff clean.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_web_not_found_recovery.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
All product files, Base layout, routes and hosting config.

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
